verdicts.reason: A is broken. The stripes have shrunk to tiny bars stuck in the bottom-left corner, a stray grey block floats with no purpose, and the URL is jammed against the top-left edge. 'for all drinkware on' is wrapped into a tiny three-line fragment pinned to the block, far from $49.99, so the price is cut off from its own copy and the reading order is jumbled. B keeps the right reading order (price, then 'for all drinkware on', URL, product list), but the brand stripes are now three small floating pills with no white card. All the copy sits loose on white, so the original's striped look is mostly gone, and there is a large empty band at the bottom.
